integrity.rule: uv lock exact file SHA256 lowercase64 or supported exact lock SHA512; npm/Bun SRI sha512-<strict base64 exactly64 decoded bytes> or sha256-<strict base64 exactly32 decoded bytes>. Normalize within a typed algorithm/digest record and verify full actual bytes, also compute independent SHA256/size. Reject ambiguous conflicting digests, missing integrity, credential-bearing URLs, unsupported Git/range/latest/local dependencies and absent selected platform/build dependencies rather than resolve latest or strip the lock. Complete platform transitive/PEP517/native-script closure is still required.

integrity.transport: Fixed root GET only for exact selected immutable lock URL, verified TLS chain+hostname, no userinfo/fragment, no credential/auth/cookie headers or inherited proxy/header configuration, no redirects or HTTP downgrade, no logging secret-bearing query. Reject origin mismatch before request. Bound actual bytes and aggregate archives/expanded closure by v132 hard ceilings; record response transport evidence privately. Lock contents alone do not add an origin. Any new origin requires source-owned reviewed refinement.

license.rule: Extract without executing package code from the exact held integrity-verified wheel/sdist/npm tarball. Validate package name/version against selected lock and member paths/duplicates/types/expansion bounds. Python records actual METADATA/PKG-INFO License-Expression and License-File member bytes where supplied; legacy License/classifier is retained as declaration only. npm records actual package.json license and exact referenced/bundled license files. No inferred license from dependency name, parent project or lock hash. Absent/ambiguous/conflicting required evidence yields unavailable with exact blocker. Metadata declaration alone is observed-declaration; reviewed-eligible requires actual root-held source-reviewed component/package license-policy receipt covering this exact package/artifact/expression/member evidence and preserving notices. Do not fabricate that verdict/policy receipt or treat a URL as the license bytes. The builder implements genuine evidence observer; source review of the selected package closure/policy is a separate task, not an unrestricted TTY license override.
